ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (21) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Разумный человек» (razumnyy chelovek, 'rational person') is 'rational' throughout, matching «разум» (razum, 'reason'), and generic «человек» keeps 'he/his/himself' where the website draft had 'they/their'. The italic «разумный человек» in the first reading keeps its italics.

Source observation: [5] «понимание своего отношения бесконечному миру» lacks the preposition «к» ('to') before «бесконечному миру» (cf. «отношения к ближайшим явлениям» in [7]); translated as 'his relation to the infinite world'.
